description: This PHP source file defines the EmpEmergencyContactDao class, which provides database access methods for managing employee emergency contact records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching emergency contacts within the HRM application.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for employee emergency contact operations in the database

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee emergency contact, assigning a sequence number if needed.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee based on employee number and contact sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingSeqNosForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of existing sequence numbers for a given employee and list of sequence numbers.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes specified emergency contacts for a given employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all emergency contacts for a specific employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Performs a search for employee emergency contacts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object based on search filters for employee emergency contacts.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee emergency contacts matching search filters.
